facts.text: Miami's Tuition Promise guarantees first-time undergraduate students that tuition, housing and meals, special purpose fees, and course fees will be frozen over four years.

sources.title: Miami's Tuition Promise | Cost of Attendance - Miami University
sources.quote: Miami's Tuition Promise will provide all first-time undergraduate students and their families the certainty that tuition, housing and meals, special purpose fees, and course fees will be frozen over the four years of a student's Miami experience.
